gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with LION ROCK TUNNEL ROAD near Sha Tin Tau Village and running generally in a north-easterly direction for about 2 240 metres where it terminates temporarily as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/ST/R12A. (It should be noted that there is a future extension of this road.)
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與獅子山隧道公路會合處近沙田頭村起，向東北伸展約二千二百四十米後暫時終止，如圖則第 NTA/ST/R12A 號中以粉紅色及黑斜線所示。(註：此路將予擴建。)

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with TAI CHUNG KIU ROAD near Tsang Tai Uk and running generally in a south-easterly direction for about 170 metres then bends to run in a generally north-easterly direction for about 730 metres where it terminates temporarily at its junction with an un-named road as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/ST/R12A. (It should be noted that there is a future extension of this street.)
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街由與大涌橋路會合處近曾大屋起，向東南伸展約一百七十米，再轉向東北伸展約七百三十米後暫時終止於與一未命名道路會合處，如圖則第 NTA/ST/R12A 號中以粉紅色及黑斜線所示。(註：此路將予擴建。)

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with an un-named road and running generally in a north-easterly direction for about 1 270 metres then turns sharply north-westerly and runs around the Fire Station for about 500 metres where it rejoins itself as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/ST/R12A.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與一未命名道路會合處起，向東北伸展約一千二百七十米，再急轉向西北伸展，環繞消防局週圍約五百米後接回原路，如圖則第 NTA/ST/R12A 號中以粉紅色及黑斜線所示。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing approximately 20 metres south-east of its junction with YUEN WO ROAD and running in a north-westerly direction for about 395 metres then bends to run in a south-westerly direction for about 15 metres where it temporarily terminates as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/ST/R12A. (It should be noted that there is a future extension of this road.)
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與源禾路會合處東南約二十米處起，向西北伸展約三百九十五米，再轉向西南伸展約十五米後暫時終止，如圖則第 NTA/ST/R12A 號中以粉紅色及黑斜線所示。(註：此路將予擴建。)

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with an un-named road (next to Fo Tan Nullah) and running in a south-westerly direction for about 235 metres where it bends sharply to curve generally in a south-easterly direction for about 520 metres where it loops clockwise for about 420 metres and then it bends to run north-westerly for about 150 metres and then bends to run south-westerly for about 110 metres where it temporarily terminates as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/ST/R12A. (It should be noted that there is a future extension of this road.)
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與(火炭渠側)一未命名道路會合處起，向西南伸展約二百三十五米，急劇轉向東南伸展約五百二十米，然後順時鐘方向以環形伸展約四百二十米，向西北伸展約一百五十米，繼向西南伸展約一百一十米後暫時終止，如圖則第 NTA/ST/R12A 號中以粉紅色及黑斜線所示。(註：此路將予擴建。)
